## AI-Generated Fix (python)

```python
from flask import Flask, make_response

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.after_request
def apply_csp(response):
    csp_policy = "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'"
    response.headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = csp_policy
    return response

@app.route('/')
def index():
    return 'Hello, World!'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8882)
```

---

## Explanation

The web application was missing a Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header, which is crucial for preventing various types of attacks such as Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). The fix involves adding a middleware function in the Flask application that sets the CSP header for all responses, restricting resources to be loaded only from the same origin ('self').
